name: Bat
description: A small cave bat that clings to its master's cloak and squeaks at hidden dangers in the dark.

name: Raven
description: A clever black raven with sharp eyes, quick to steal shiny things and carry whispered messages.

name: Owl
description: A silent gray owl with golden eyes that keeps watch through the night and misses nothing.

name: Hawk
description: A swift red-tailed hawk that dives on prey and returns faithfully to its master's arm.

name: Harpy
description: A shrieking harpy with a wild face and razor talons, fiercely protective of those it chooses.

name: Phoenix
description: A radiant bird of living flame that rises reborn from its own ashes, trailing golden embers.

name: Rat
description: A scruffy sewer rat with twitching whiskers, small enough to squeeze through any crack.

name: Ferret
description: A sleek, playful ferret that slips into burrows and returns with things it was never meant to find.

name: Fox
description: A russet fox with a bushy tail and cunning eyes, silent on the trail and wary of traps.

name: Shadowcat
description: A smoky black cat that melts into shadows and reappears wherever it pleases.

name: Moonhare
description: A silver-furred hare that glows faintly under the moon and bounds between places in a blink.

name: Kitsune
description: A nine-tailed spirit fox wreathed in pale blue foxfire, wise, mischievous and deeply magical.

name: Glowmoth
description: A pale moth whose wings shed soft arcane light, drawn to spellcasters like a flame.

name: Crystal Lizard
description: A small lizard with gemstone scales that hum and glitter whenever magic is near.

name: Living Grimoire
description: A floating spellbook that flaps its pages like wings and mutters forgotten incantations.

name: Blink Hound
description: A spectral hound that vanishes in a flash of violet light and reappears at its master's side.

name: Mandrake
description: A root creature pulled from the soil whose scream can stun foes, loyal to whoever dared to unearth it.

name: Astral Familiar
description: A shimmering being of starlight that shares its master's mind and bends the flow of magic itself.

name: Wisp
description: A flickering will-o'-the-wisp that lights the way and drifts ahead into the unknown.

name: Fairy
description: A tiny winged fairy that sprinkles glittering dust and giggles at the misfortune of enemies.

name: Sprite
description: A tiny glimmering sprite that darts between flowers and streams, leaving trails of dewdrop light.

name: Homunculus
description: An alchemically grown homunculus bound to its creator, sharing sight and whispered thoughts.

name: Djinn
description: A smoky blue djinn bound to a lamp-like seal, swirling with wind and old desert magic.

name: Seraph
description: A six-winged celestial seraph wreathed in holy light, a guardian from beyond the stars.

name: Crab
description: A small shore crab with one oversized claw, snapping at anything that comes too close.

name: Otter
description: A playful river otter that dives for fish and shiny pebbles and floats happily on its back.

name: Octopus
description: A clever octopus that changes color at will and slips its arms into every lock and crevice.

name: Selkie
description: A gentle selkie that sheds its sealskin to walk ashore, singing softly of the deep.

name: Siren
description: A haunting siren whose song lures foes to their doom and calms the stormiest seas.

name: Water Elemental
description: A living wave of shimmering water that crashes over enemies and reforms from every spilled drop.

name: Witch Toad
description: A warty black toad with glowing yellow eyes, the classic witch's familiar, croaking curses at its master's foes.

name: Imp
description: A tiny glimmering sprite that darts between flowers and streams, leaving trails of dewdrop light.

name: Hellhound
description: A lean black hound with smoldering fur and burning eyes, leaving scorched pawprints wherever it hunts.

name: Wraith
description: A hooded, shadowy wraith that drifts at its master's side and drains the warmth from anyone it touches.

name: Shadow Demon
description: A demon of living darkness that slips between shadows and whispers dreadful secrets to its master.

name: Abyssal Horror
description: A tentacled horror from the abyss with countless eyes, bound to its master by a pact no mortal should make.

name: Lost Soul
description: A faint, flickering soul newly parted from its body, clinging close and unsure of where else to go.

name: Poltergeist
description: A restless, unseen spirit that rattles doors and knocks objects loose, more prankster than threat.

name: Ancestral Shade
description: The translucent form of a forebear, watching over its bloodline and murmuring half-remembered warnings.

name: Banshee
description: A wailing spirit whose cry rises before danger finds its charge, mourning deaths not yet come.

name: Revenant
description: A vengeful ancestor returned from the grave, standing between its descendant and any who'd harm them.

name: Lich
description: An undead sorcerer of terrible age, bound not by fear but by an old debt, lending its master centuries of stolen power.
